item.title: Setting Up Orca Desktop IDE to Manage Multiple AI Coding Agents
item.description: Learn how to install and configure Orca, a desktop IDE that isolates multiple CLI coding agents like Codex and Claude Code using Git Worktrees.

item.title: How Orca ADE Runs Parallel Coding Agents on a Mac mini
item.description: Starting from a developer’s Mac mini server setup, explore how Orca ADE isolates parallel agent tasks using Git worktrees, remote execution, and diff reviews.

item.title: 12. Racing Three Coding Agents in Isolated Git Worktrees
item.description: Running multiple coding agents in one checkout kept breaking my builds. I moved to git worktree isolation and a race workflow: three different models on the same task, with the open-source tool Orca handling the setup.

item.title: How a Claude Code Designer Prototypes with AI and Git Worktrees
item.description: A look inside the Claude Code lead designer’s AI prototyping workflow using parallel CLI sessions and git worktrees.
